sloka: श्रुत्वैवं वचनं तस्या मन्थरायास्तु कैकयि ।किंचिदुत्थाय शयनात्स्वास्तीर्णादिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-९-८॥
transliteration: śrutvaivaṁ vacanaṁ tasyā mantharāyāstu kaikayi ।kiṁcidutthāya śayanātsvāstīrṇādidamabravīt ॥2-9-8॥

translations.english: After hearing Manthara's words, Kaikeyi got up a little from her wellspread bed and said this:
